verdict.rationale: Semgrep's marketing claims it combines AI reasoning with rule-based analysis for remediation and can 'scan and fix' code. Concrete fix evidence covers only rule-defined autofix via the `--autofix` flag, which edits local files deterministically rather than through AI. Semgrep Assistant (AI) is documented only for post-processing findings to reduce noise. Missing for 10: documentation of AI-generated fix suggestions, automatic drafting of remediation pull requests, a review-and-merge workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
